# Blackline 0.15.131

* Emoji are drawn exactly the way Discord draws them: a picture, 1.375em square beside text and 3em alone, aligned to the bottom of the line — not a font glyph sitting wherever the font puts it. Message text is 16px/22px, as theirs is.
* The same picture is used everywhere: messages, reactions, the tray, menus and the message bar.
